transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm just having some issues at work lately. I keep making... just dumb mistakes on my sales reports. Like copying the wrong numbers from the team dashboard, or missing a line in a procedure I'm supposed to check. 

Even when I thought I already went over it, I still mess it up. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you had trouble paying attention like this since you were a child?

Yeah, I guess so. My mom still brings it up sometimes. She says my elementary school teachers were always sending notes home... saying I hurried through my assignments and made mistakes, or that I lost my homework. And that I'd talk when I wasn't supposed to, or just... couldn't stay in my chair unless they told me to sit down. So, yeah. I guess it's been a while.
Do you still often feel restless or have trouble staying seated when you're expected to?

Um... yeah, I guess. I mean, sitting through a long meeting is... well, it's hard. 

It kind of feels like my body is just... buzzing inside. I end up having to shift around a lot, or... tap my foot. Sometimes I just make an excuse to get up for a minute. So, yeah.
Do you often interrupt people before they’ve finished speaking?

Yeah, I suppose I do. 

Um... especially in meetings. If someone's talking, I just kind of... jump in. I usually think I know where they're going with it, so I just say it. But then... half the time I realize I answered the wrong thing, or I just... cut them off. So, yeah. I guess that happens.
Do these attention problems also cause difficulties for you outside of work, like at home or in daily life?

Um... yeah. I guess it does. 

At home, it just... it causes some conflict. I guess people feel like they can't really count on me to follow through on things. And... well, it's not just outside of work, either. It's gotten to the point where my manager actually put it in a formal review. So... yeah. It affects things.
Do you often find yourself worrying excessively about many different things?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I have normal stress, I guess, but... no, I don't just sit around worrying about everything.
Have these attention and restlessness problems been present pretty consistently since childhood?

Yeah... I suppose. I was like this as a kid, too. 

Um... my mom actually still brings it up sometimes. Like, old notes from teachers back in elementary school. Saying I rushed through my work, or... lost my homework. And, uh... talking out of turn, or needing to be reminded to just stay in my seat. So... yeah. It's always been like this, I guess.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
No. I mean, not really. I don't feel... depressed. Just frustrated with myself sometimes, but that's about it.
Do you often have trouble organizing tasks or keeping your work in order?
Yeah, I guess so. I mean, my desk is always a mess. I lose track of things a lot. It's... yeah, it's pretty disorganized.
